sections.h: They pick the miner that gives the most hash per dollar
p: Shoppers here run the maths before they buy. {imp_iv_cmv5n9mtw0000vg21hfila9o7} bought each time a deal landed in his price-per-terahash range. {imp_iv_cmpq5psvm0000ky04c88i9usa} worked out that several small units beat one big one on hashrate. {imp_iv_cmpa18xcz0007ld04ql6050al} saw a pricey unit with little hash and asked to see something stronger.
Right now they have to do that division in their heads, or on another tab. Put the number on the page and the best value picks itself, on our site rather than someone else's.

frame.obstacle: working out the cost per terahash themselves, one product at a time
frame.competitor: buying several small miners or one bigger one

chat.Why not just lower prices?: They aren't only hunting the lowest price. They want the best hash for the money, and a sale only wins them over when it shows up in that number.
chat.Which shoppers care most?: Budget and tinkerer buyers, plus anyone choosing between several small units and one larger one.

sections.h: They check other stores, and we often come out ahead
p: Most buyers compare before they check out. {imp_iv_cmpnl2o4o0000l204j3j09fmw} found our miner resold for more on Amazon and called our offer way better. {imp_iv_cmonkx7da0000vgd2avm9kwcc} bought because the price was fair next to the other sites. {imp_iv_cmpezvixp0000l804feuupncr} was still holding out for cheaper eBay auctions.
When we're cheaper, shoppers should see that without opening another tab. When we aren't, they leave to look.

chat.Do they trust our prices?: Mostly yes. Several said our prices were good or better than Amazon. The doubt comes from cheaper auction listings.
chat.Who do they see as overpriced?: One shopper called bitcoin merch dot com overpriced and gimmicky, so our fair-price image is an advantage.

sections.h: They mine solo for the dream of hitting a block
p: Many buyers aren't chasing returns. They're buying a lottery ticket that runs all day. {imp_iv_cmpomddzs0002js047o7vx2fe} dreams of waking up to a block he found himself. {imp_iv_cmpltzezd0000if044cfutnmo} wants another miner because a friend's unit already hit one. {imp_iv_cmvfk4kaw000mvg0h4pgx4x6x} knows he probably won't win but says it'll be fun.
Real wins drive their buying. Every story of a home miner hitting a block is a reason to buy the next unit.

pinned.title: Shoppers buy on price per terahash
pinned.move: Show each miner's price per terahash right next to its price on every product and collection page, so shoppers can compare without leaving the store.
pinned.ask: When you compare miners, how do you work out the price per terahash, and what makes one feel like a deal?

chat.Don't they just want the lowest price?: Not quite. They judge the price against the hashrate it buys, and a sale gets them to buy when that number looks good.
chat.Does this help our small miners or hurt: It can help them. One shopper pointed out that several small units can add up to more terahash than one big one for the same money.

pinned.why: In 26 of 110 interviews, shoppers raised this: they pick a miner by what each terahash costs, and some see several small units as a better deal than one big one.

email.subject: Shoppers buy on price per terahash
email.pre: In 26 of 110 interviews, shoppers raised this: they pick a miner by what each terahash costs, and some see several small units as a better deal than one big one.
email.head: Shoppers buy on price per terahash
email.move: Show each miner's price per terahash right next to its price on every product and collection page, so shoppers can compare without leaving the store.
